description.text:
Job Description
- Develop and maintain automated test scripts for web applications
- Execute automation and regression tests
- Assist in maintaining existing automation testing frameworks
- Collaborate with developers to identify and report defects
- Improve automation scripts to increase test stability
- Participate in test case design and testing activities
Requirements
- 0–2 years experience in software testing or automation testing
- Familiar with web automation tools such as Selenium or Playwright
- Programming experience in Python
- Understanding of software testing methodologies
Nice to Have
- Experience with API testing
- Experience with pytest
- Experience with Git
- Basic knowledge of HTML / CSS / DOM
